    # Preserve the bottom pattern and the rightmost object above the divider.
    bottom = [(r, c) for r in range(7, len(grid)) for c,v in enumerate(grid[r]) if v == 1]
    color = next(v for v in grid[1] if v not in (0, 1, 2, 5))

    minr, maxr = min(r for r,c in pts), max(r for r,c in pts)
    minc, maxc = min(c for r,c in pts), max(c for r,c in pts)
    shp=[(r-minr,c-minc) for r,c in pts]
    # output stacks the selected object over the lower object, with lower shape centered in its source column
    out=[[0]*15 for _ in range(9)]
    bminr=min(r for r,c in bottom); bmaxr=max(r for r,c in bottom)
    bminc=min(c for r,c in bottom); bmaxc=max(c for r,c in bottom)

    for dr,dc in shp:

    return out
'''
